name: Fables
overview: Scripture uses fables, parables, and riddles as teaching tools to convey spiritual truths, often illustrated through symbolic stories like the trees seeking a king (Judges 9:8) or the use of parables by Jesus to instruct the multitude (Matthew 13:34). While these forms can reveal deep wisdom, the Bible also warns against being deceived by false teachings and cunning craftiness that distort truth (Ephesians 4:14). Therefore, believers are called to discern carefully the message behind such stories, distinguishing godly instruction from foolish or misleading speech (Proverbs 26:7; Ezekiel 17:2).
